title: Chemical Plant Design and Environmental Impact

**Continuous processing:** reactants flow continuously through the plant. Used for large-scale production: petroleum refining, ammonia synthesis. Advantages: consistent quality, lower cost per unit, easier automation.

**Batch processing:** reactants loaded in batches, reaction occurs, products removed. Used for smaller scale or specialty chemicals: pharmaceuticals, dyes, polymers. Advantages: flexibility, easier changeover.
**Economic factors:** raw material cost, energy efficiency, yield, equipment depreciation, labour, waste treatment, market price of product.

**Environmental impact:** air pollution (SO2, NOx, particulates), water pollution (heavy metals, organic toxins), soil contamination, greenhouse gas emissions. Modern plants use scrubbers, effluent treatment, and green chemistry principles to minimise impact.
